Node for .env exists but has no incoming edges from scripts that load it. Should have edges from src/setup.js, GuardDog classes, and telegram-alert.js showing environment variable dependencies.

recommendations: REFACTOR: Consolidate duplicate scanner modules. Choose canonical locations: use src/scanners/ for all scanner implementations (virustotal, reputation, cve, threat-intel, pattern). Redirect src/index.js to import from canonical locations.

REFACTOR: Consolidate src/index.js and src/core/guard-dog.js into single GuardDog class. If enhanced version (core) is the target, migrate all callers to src/core/guard-dog.js and delete src/index.js, or clearly document the legacy vs. enhanced distinction.
NORMALIZE: Fix node ID prefixes. Use consistent naming: 'file:path', 'config:path', 'document:path' (no double 'file:file_' or 'config:file_'). Rebuild graph with corrected IDs.

ADD EDGES: Create explicit edges from bin/ scripts to their actual imports. Trace threat-intel-daily.js, mission-control-trigger.js, and bin/nightly-scan.js to verify they correctly reference the active implementation (src/index.js vs src/core/guard-dog.js).

ADD EDGES: Add edges showing environment variable dependencies. src/.env should have outgoing edges to all modules that read VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, GITHUB_API_TOKEN.

CLARIFY: Document which ThreatIntel version is canonical (src/threat-intel.js with ecosystem-safe NVD filtering vs. src/scanners/threat-intel.js). Add note to threat-intel-daily.js showing which it uses.

VALIDATION: Verify that all shell scripts (consolidate-logs.sh, git-precommit-hook.sh, npm-postinstall-hook.sh, setup-logging-structure.sh, cron-nightly-scan.sh) actually exist and have correct paths. Some may be outdated or moved to bin/.
DOCUMENTATION: Add a layer diagram showing: CLI entry points (bin/) → Main orchestrator (src/index.js or src/core/guard-dog.js) → Scanners (src/scanners/) → Config (config/). Currently unclear.
REVIEW: Check if tunnel-health-check.js actually belongs in guard-dog project or if it's a reference to external module. The 'telegram-send shared module' reference needs clarification.
CLEANUP: Remove or archive orphaned documents (LICENSE, INDEX.md have minimal edges). If they're essential, add edges showing dependencies or references from the main flow.
TESTING: Add test node and edge relationships showing test coverage. Currently no test files appear in graph (tests/ directory mentioned in .gitignore but no nodes exist).

COMPLEXITY: Review why all nodes default to 'moderate' complexity. This is too coarse. Differentiate between simple utilities (module-loader, paths) and complex orchestrators (guard-dog, decision-tree).
summary: The graph has 52 nodes with reasonable connectivity (95 edges), but is fragmented by duplicate implementations and inconsistent naming. Primary issues: (1) Multiple versions of core modules (GuardDog, scanners) exist simultaneously without clear canonical paths; (2) Node ID prefixes are inconsistent ('file:file_', 'config:file_', 'document:file_'); (3) 8 nodes use invalid types ('script', 'utility', 'configuration') that require remapping; (4) Several key edges are missing between bin/ scripts and their actual imports, making execution flow unclear; (5) Environment variable dependencies are not explicitly modeled; (6) No test coverage is represented. The refactoring from src/ to src/core/scanners/ structure appears incomplete — both old and new paths coexist, creating ambiguity about which implementation is active. After consolidating duplicates and normalizing IDs, the graph should be re-assembled to clarify the true architecture.
